🔊 Funeral ceremonies of martyred Leader should symbolize national unity and cohesion: President

📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian has reiterated his call for maintaining national unity and cohesion, saying that these should symbolize in the farewell and burial ceremonies for the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei, and several of his family members.

Addressing a cabinet meeting on Wednesday, Pezeshkian described the upcoming event as significant and historic, appreciating the organizations and committees overseeing the funeral arrangements in the capital Tehran, as well as the holy cities of Qom and Mashhad.
​
He noted that the Leader's esteemed family has invited officials from executive bodies, various institutions, and organizations, as well as the noble people of Iran, to attend the ceremonies and bid farewell to the martyrs.
​
Pezeshkian outlined a number of issues during the session, including the outcome of his recent meetings with top scholars and sources of jurisprudence in the holy city of Qom and their positive assessment of the government functioning.
​
Stating that prominent Iranian clerics supported and appreciated the government's actions in the current critical situation of the country, the President emphasized the continuation of his administration's livelihood programs, utilizing the domestic capacity and national unity.
​
He also thanked these dignitaries for offering valuable tips, recommendations, and perspectives in various fields, adding that one of the important concerns raised by them was dedicated to people's livelihood and the necessity of supporting different segments of society.
​
Referring to recent understandings and agreements, in the economic and trade fields, Pezeshkian said that the religious authorities and prominent professors at the Qom seminary expressed their satisfaction with the process that has taken place and considered it a positive step towards securing national interests.
​
Appreciating the efforts of different ministries, the President said the government was ready to listen to all experts and academics of relevant fields and use their specialized and advisory opinions at any time to improve the decision-making process and solve the country's problems.
​
During the meeting, Pezeshkian also hailed national sporting teams for bringing glory to the Iranian flag and the Islamic Republic, emphasizing that the Iranian nation, relying on internal unity and cohesion and strengthening convergence among Islamic countries, will continue the path of dignity, independence and progress.

Crypto Idea

The boldest experiment in crypto

Michael Saylor, the founder of Strategy, the world's largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, has come up with something unique.

Instead of simply buying Bitcoin with the company's own money, he's building an entire financial machine that attracts outside capital and channels it into BTC purchases.

One of these instruments is STRC. Investors provide capital to the company and receive regular payouts of around 11.5% annually. The company then uses that capital to buy Bitcoin. But there's a catch.

⚙️ How it’s supposed to work

STRC — an instrument Saylor designed with the help of AI — is intended to keep its price hovering around $100.

If the price falls, the company raises the yield to attract more buyers. The price is supposed to recover. Think of it as an automatic stabilizer.

❓ Why this is interesting 

Right now, STRC is trading at roughly $83, despite its $100 target value. The yield has already been increased, but the market isn't responding the way the model was designed to.

This is the first real stress test of the entire structure. If the mechanism fails to stabilize the price, the company will either have to keep increasing payouts to investors or buy less Bitcoin.

Saylor is essentially testing one question: can financial instruments be built around a single asset indefinitely?

Euro Digital: Europe is preparing money that will work even without the internet

Euro digital has taken a new step forward in Brussels.

The idea is for any citizen to be able to pay with a digital version of the euro, issued by the European Central Bank (ECB), including without an internet connection.

Payments can be made with a phone, card, online, and offline - and rely less on Visa, Mastercard, and private banks.

### What is already raising questions:
- Limits will be set on how much digital euros can be stored.
- Many stores may be required to accept it.
- Banks fear that some of the money will be taken from their accounts.
- Millions of citizens are concerned about privacy of data.

The ECB promises that digital euro will not replace cash, and offline payments will have an increased level of confidentiality (similar to cash).

However, the discussion in Europe has long gone beyond just the technology.

This is a question of power: do we need public digital money or are we opening the door to too much control over how we pay?

📌 Real Yield: How to tell true DeFi returns apart from a ponzi scheme

Key Takeaways
⏺ Many protocols attract users by promising hundreds of percent in annual yields
⏺ Often, this yield is hollow and is sustained solely by printing endless new tokens
⏺ This post breaks down the concept of Real Yield and why it represents the future of sane crypto

1️⃣ The Printing Press — In past cycles, most DeFi projects lured people with 100-500% annual percentage yields (APY). The catch was that you were paid in the project's own native tokens, which crashed due to hyper-inflation.
2️⃣ What is Real Yield — This is a model where a protocol shares its actual business revenue with investors. The platform makes real money from transaction, swap, or borrowing fees and distributes a portion to users.
3️⃣ Payout Currency — With Real Yield, you are not compensated in volatile native rewards. Instead, you receive highly liquid, hard assets, usually stablecoins like USDT/USDC or blue-chip native coins like Ethereum (ETH).
4️⃣ Sustainability — Even though the yields are more modest (typically 5-15% APY), this framework does not rely on a constant influx of new buyers. As long as people use the platform, you get a cut of the action.
5️⃣ Practice — Before locking up your capital for attractive yields, always investigate the Revenue Distribution model and verify exactly where the payout money is generated.

The Bottom Line

If a protocol promises massive returns paid out in its own token, you are just participating in an inflationary race. A healthy DeFi project must generate actual fee revenue and distribute true profits.
